lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the fifth branchial slit, exhibiting a semi-regular grid distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a localized grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, transition from high-intensity reflection to lower-intensity shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Visible distribution of roughly circular high-luminance spots on the first dorsal fin, though partially obscured by high-frequency light caustics from the water surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin; secondary smaller indentations visible on the same margin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light patterns across the dorsal surface resulting from surface-level light refraction.
